Jointly set dropout=0.2, Adam LR=0.0005, weight_decay=0.00001 and batch_size=256. category_rationales.rationale: Add a jointly trained residual feed-forward block of width 2H after every GRU state: LayerNorm(h + W2 GELU(W1 h)). Apply it consistently to supervised positions and candidate inference across all four datasets. Preserve tied embeddings, final-real-position readout and BPR. The generated predictor imports the updated architecture and restores its parameters from each category's single checkpoint.

Jointly set dropout to 0.2, Adam learning rate to 0.0005, weight decay to 0.00001 and batch size to 256. Lower learning rate and stronger regularization control the residual block's added capacity, while larger batches stabilize updates. Preserve history length, dimensions, epoch cap and batches per epoch. Enforce the required environment-only data path.
